Openclaw
Intro
OpenClaw doesnt think, it doesnt reason. Its just inputs, cues and a loop. But
do you have seen the videos agents calling their ownser at 3 am, ordering sushi
because you didnt buy groceries, texted with your wife without you knowing.
And everybody questions why does it feel alive ? Is AGI happening ?
Example:
Openclaw 1

 Openclaw 2

Main architecture
Simply said OpenClaw is just an agent runtime with a gateway in front of it. A
gateway that routes inputs to agents. The agents do the work and the gateway
is just managing their traffics.
The gateway is simple. It sits on your machine constantly accepting
connections. It connects to your messaging apps, whatsapp, telegram,
whatsapp etc. and it routes messages to the ai agent that can actually do things
on your computer.
But here is what most people miss. The gateway doesnt think, doesnt reason
and doesnt decide anything interesting. All it does is accepting inputs and route
them to the right place.
So what makes OpenClaw feel alive ? Its basically just messages from humans,
heartbeats from a timer, crownjobs on a schedule, hooks from a internal state
and webhooks from external systems. Plus as a bonus agents can message
other agents.
Openclaw 3

Every input is lined up in a queue, handled by agents and sessions saved in
markdown files you can read on your system.
Its proactive. It responds and it remembers which makes the feeling that its
alive.
Example
Now coming back to the example I shared earlier. From the outside it looks
autonomous. The agent decided to get a phone number and call the owner. It
decided to call and waited until 3 am.
But here is what really happens under the hood.
Some event fired ( maybe a crownjob, a heartbeat we dont really know). Then it
enters the gateway, the agents processes it with all the avaible tools it had,
aquired the phone numer and made a call. The ownder didnt ask for htis
moment but somewher ein the setup the behavior was instructed. Time
produced an event. The event started an agent, followed its instrucitons.
Nothing was about thinking and being alive. It was just responding.
Openclaw 4

Ending
So to summarize its not alive. Its just a system that reacts, remembers and act.
But sometimes its not even that. Its just hype.
